description: PR adds monolith 500-line function that should be split; no consideration for prior lessons

contextPayload.reasonSummary: PR#997 adds a 500-line runDiagnosticPipeline() function that handles context assembly, LLM invocation, output validation, candidate commit, and admission in a single function. This violates the split-responsibility principle (T-09) and ignores the prior lesson from ERR-045 where a similar monolith caused cascading failures (T-10).

evidence.note: Prior monolith caused cascading failures — lesson not applied
Validation and commit interleaved — cannot test independently
